findings.title: Import guards in identify chain required logging to reach baseline 0
findings.description: The identify modules (from prior BP11 legs) used broad Exception handlers as import guards and error recovery. These were counted as silent. Added logging.debug() calls to all broad-except handlers to make them non-silent, bringing identify files to the required baseline of 0.
